description: Returns recent seismic events from the Icelandic Meteorological Office (Veðurstofa Íslands, api.vedur.is/quakes), filtered by minimum magnitude, lookback hours (1-168), and optional region/seismic zone, newest first (max 20), plus explicit felt-earthquake API availability metadata.

region.description: Optional region or seismic zone filter (e.g. Reykjanes, Svartsengi, Askja, Katla, Bárðarbunga, Tjörnes, South).

name: get_recent_earthquakes
title: Get Recent Earthquakes in Iceland
